title: A booking problem at the hotel
es: Resolver un problema de reserva y quejarte con cortesía
goal: Explicar un problema, pedir una solución concreta y negociar una compensación sin perder la calma.
phrases: I have a reservation under the name of...
Tengo una reserva a nombre de...
There seems to have been a mix-up.
I'd appreciate it if you could...
Me temo que eso no es aceptable.

turns.t: Good evening, and welcome to the Grand Harbour Hotel. May I have your name and a booking reference, please?
turns.es: Buenas noches y bienvenido al Grand Harbour Hotel. ¿Me da su nombre y la referencia de la reserva?

y.say: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name of Camargo for three nights, and the reference is on my confirmation email.
y.es: Buenas noches. Tengo una reserva a nombre de Camargo por tres noches y la referencia está en mi correo de confirmación.
alts: Good evening. There is a booking for Camargo for three nights and the reference is in my email.

turns.t: Thank you. Hmm, that's strange. I can see a booking for that name, but it's for next week, not tonight. And to make matters worse, we're fully booked this evening because of a conference in town.
turns.es: Gracias. Qué raro. Veo una reserva con ese nombre pero es para la próxima semana, no hoy. Y para colmo estamos llenos esta noche por una conferencia en la ciudad.

c.q: What is the problem with the reservation?
o: It is for the wrong week

y.say: There seems to have been a mix-up, because I booked for tonight and I have the confirmation. I've been travelling for ten hours, so I really need a room.
y.es: Parece que hubo una confusión, porque reservé para hoy y tengo la confirmación. He viajado diez horas, así que realmente necesito una habitación.
alts: It looks like there was a mistake. I booked for tonight, I have the confirmation, and I have travelled for ten hours so I need a room.

turns.t: I completely understand, and I apologise for the inconvenience. Let me check with my manager. One option is a room in our sister hotel, five minutes away by taxi. We would cover the transfer and give you a free breakfast tomorrow.
turns.es: Lo entiendo perfectamente y me disculpo por las molestias. Consultaré con mi gerente. Una opción es una habitación en nuestro hotel hermano, a cinco minutos en taxi. Cubriríamos el traslado y desayuno gratis mañana.

y.say: That's a start, but I'd appreciate it if you could also cover the second night, since this mistake wasn't my fault.
y.es: Es un comienzo, pero le agradecería que también cubriera la segunda noche, ya que este error no fue mi culpa.
alts: That helps, but could you also pay for the second night? The mistake was not my fault.

turns.t: I see your point. Normally we can't offer that, but given the circumstances, I think we can give you a fifty per cent discount on the second night. Would that be acceptable?
turns.es: Entiendo. Normalmente no podemos, pero dadas las circunstancias, podemos darle un cincuenta por ciento de descuento en la segunda noche. ¿Le parece aceptable?

y.say: Fifty per cent is fair, provided that the room has a proper desk, because I need to work tomorrow morning. Would it be possible to check that first?
y.es: El cincuenta por ciento es justo, siempre que la habitación tenga un escritorio adecuado, porque tengo que trabajar mañana. ¿Sería posible comprobarlo primero?
alts: Fifty percent is reasonable as long as the room has a good desk, I have to work in the morning. Could you check it first?

turns.t: Of course, I'll call them right now. Yes, they do have a desk and fast wifi. I'll book the taxi and send the details to your phone. Again, we're truly sorry about this.
turns.es: Claro, los llamo ahora. Sí, tienen escritorio y wifi rápido. Reservo el taxi y envío los datos a su teléfono. De nuevo, lo sentimos mucho.

c.q: What will the hotel do for the guest?
o: Offer a room elsewhere, a taxi and a discount
Give him a refund and nothing else
Ask him to come back next week

y.say: Thank you for handling this so professionally. I'll leave a positive review if everything goes smoothly tomorrow.
y.es: Gracias por manejar esto tan profesionalmente. Dejaré una reseña positiva si todo sale bien mañana.
alts: Thanks for dealing with this so well. I will write a good review if everything goes well tomorrow.
